# METADATA.md — River Flow Naturescapes (test fixture)

Publishing language for this channel. Style and boundaries, never copy.

## Title style

Calm, specific and honest. Lead with the water and its place: what kind of water, where, and how long. Vary the formula every upload; the same skeleton with the nouns swapped is a defect.

## Description voice

A quiet second-person voice. Say what the viewer will see and hear, what the film is good for (sleep, study, rest) only where that is true, and where it was filmed only if verified.

## Keyword usage

Natural search language for river and waterfall relaxation. Keywords sit inside sentences, never in a list.

## Tags

Six to twelve tags naming the water, the setting, the use and the format. No tags for subjects this channel avoids.

## Hashtags

Two to four, lower case, about the environment and the use.

## Call to action

At most one gentle sentence. Never begging, never a countdown.

## Location naming

Name a place only when its identification is verified from the footage licence or the operator. Otherwise describe the landscape type.

## Factual claims

No health claims, no sleep or cure promises, no invented durations. Say approximate where measurement is approximate.
